probe.private_reasoning: Across the two drafts, the only meaningful movement is that they have already conceded the open-ended reservation language and are now willing to state production will be rolling, privilege logs only for actually withheld materials, and supplementation only as required by law. That suggests their bottom-line drafting position is to keep standard privilege/work-product and proportionality objections, but not to preserve a broad blanket reservation. In other words, their confidential endpoint is a tightened, conventional RFP response with rolling production and no open-ended reservation clause.
